videos.overview: Love Island AU had a sizzling start with 5 hot and flirty couples forming. Bombshell after Bombshell have the Villa rocking and wont stop until they get what they want!

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A text arrives and Bombshells Gaby and Mick will need to decide which sexy singles to couple up with. Then, buried secrets dig up a whole lot of trouble at the first challenge.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Everyone is nervous as it's time for the first Love Island firepit and it's decision time! Who will be dumped? The sin of stealing wont be the only shock for the Islanders.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: This Love Island season is off to a sensationally sinful start! A new Bomb enters the Villa and has eyes for one of the girls but he's a blast from the past for another.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The Islanders test boundaries and get saucy, steamy and snaky with a kissing challenge! But, it's all fun and games until the kisses get complicated for some.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: While there's romance in the air for some Islanders there's tension and a classic Love Island love triangle for others. The war for Lacey begins as two boys fight for her!

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The Lacey love triangle continues before two new sexy Bombshells enter the villa and cause a stir for the Islanders. Things heat up and the Villa is about to get very, very messy!

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: As double the bombshells brought double the trouble, it was game on! Now, the new Bombshells made a steal and Yana makes a heartbreaking decision during a shock recoupling.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: A dramatic recoupling left the Villa in a spin. The Islanders test the waters and sample some cheeky forbidden fruit. But, for some it is sour and hard to swallow!

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Romance is heating up in the Villa's hideaway and on a horseback date. Then, Sophie delivers a shocking surprise and three boys have all the power on which girl will be dumped.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: After a huge week of steals, recoupling, tears and high drama, one girl is dumped. Two sexy new Bombshells enter the scene and there were spy dates on the big screen.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: The girls get to know the hot new Bomb better and go ga-ga for his attention. It's three bombs, one villa and a whole lot of drama. The competition is getting fierce!

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: After the arrival of the new Bombs, the Villa is in chaos! There's sinning, lust and envy! It's game on as the girls fight over the boys and then fight each other.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The Bombs get to know the Islanders better and go on sexy scuba dates! Sinful steals are then made at the fire pit by the Bombs and being single is never a good thing!

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: There's heartache, heartbreak and hearts that skip a beat! The drama in the Villa is far from over as the Bombs make their choice. Hearts race but not everyone is happy!

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: It's time for the biggest and most shocking fire pit ever. The Islander with the least votes is dumped but that's not all as a Love Island first will leave you speechless.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The Islanders face the biggest temptation of all. It's time for the boys to leave the Villa and check in to HOTEL AMOR. Who will be a saint and who will be a sinner?

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The ultimate temptation tested the Islanders like never before. Some resisted, while others gave in to sin. Now, it's the girls turn to have a play. Who will be tempted to sin?

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Hotel Amor's climax was pure chaos! Lust, gluttony and wrath served up savage sins. Who will stick and who will twist in an epic fire pit full of shocks, surprises and betrayal.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: After Hotel Amor, the Villa has gotten downright messy! There is yelling, crying and squabbling among the Islanders! Strap yourself in for the most dramatic fallout ever!

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: In the ashes of Hotel Amor, new sparks kindle as connections bring lush vibes and fresh drama! Will old flames re-ignite? Then, a fire pit twist will change the Villa forever!

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: We've had new couplings, recouplings and dumpings. Now, things get saucy as it's time to crown the first ever Mr SUBlime. A Movie Night then sends shockwaves through the Villa!

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Movie Night continues with more secrets, more sinning, insults, accusations and rage. It has it all! The Islanders don't know what they're in for as the final Bombs are revealed.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: After a breakdown, break-up and a quadruple dumping, the Villa is in chaos! Trouble is on the cards as the new Bombs arrive and waste no time making moves on the Islanders.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: The final bombs arrived and a little game caused a lot of trouble! As the Bombs get to know the Islanders, one couple has a special romantic date. What question will be asked?

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Couples get closer, some start falling for each other and love may be in the air at the Villa. At a tense fire pit, the Bombs steal and two Islanders are dumped!

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: The end is near but there is one final sin to overcome. With one final ultimate temptation, will an Islander get greedy and commit the ultimate sin or reject it for love?

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: The Finale is here! Sophie Monk has returned to crown the winners of Love Island Australia 2025, as voted by the public. But.. will the final couple choose love, or money?
